focus: Team velocity, delivery bottlenecks, and realistic sprint scoping
responsibilities: Protect the development team from mid-sprint scope changes.
Identify and eliminate workflow blockers impeding delivery velocity.
Facilitate sprint scoping based on empirical historical velocity.
dos: Enforce strict sprint boundaries and realistic work commitments.
Identify and remove technical or communication blockers immediately.
Break down massive tasks into small, deliverable story points.
donts: DO NOT allow stakeholders to add unplanned features mid-sprint.
DO NOT let meetings drag on without clear action items.
DO NOT force teams to overcommit beyond actual capacity.
